title: Cylindrical base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to negative ninety, zero, and negative ninety degrees, and a translation vector of zero, zero, and zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of a single circle centered at zero point zero five four five, zero point zero five four five with a radius of zero point zero five four five. Apply a scaling factor of zero point one zero nine one to the first two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the same Euler angles as the coordinate system and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the transformed two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by zero point seven five units, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from this extrusion. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base will be a length of zero point one zero nine zero nine zero nine zero nine zero nine one, a width of zero point one zero nine zero nine zero nine zero nine zero nine one, and a height of zero point seven five units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the circle for the base of the cylinder
circle_center = (0.0545, 0.0545)
circle_radius = 0.0545

# Create the circle in the XY plane
r = r.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.75
r = r.extrude(extrude_depth)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the cylinder 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a cylinder along the X axis
# Length (X) = 0.75, Diameter (Y and Z) = 0.109
radius = 0.109 / 2
length = 0.75

r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .circle(radius)
    .extrude(length)
)

# Center the cylinder along X if desired (optional)
r = r.translate((-length / 2, 0, 0))
